What if the garden could give your home another room?

The problem
The house may no longer provide enough space.
Work A desk at the kitchen table, every day.
Family Children who need somewhere loud, and parents who need somewhere quiet.
Guests and hobbies A spare room that is never spare.
The usual answers Move house, or extend the one you are living in.
The possibility
What could stand at the end of the garden?
Three kinds of building, and they are not the same project.
And one that is neither
A home in the garden that would be sold, subdivided or lived in apart from the main house is an independent dwelling. It falls outside the 2026 exemption, so it needs planning permission.

homeownerImprovement.declared: 2026-11-04, founder approval 'DISC-008 homeowner experience improvement': the early prompt goes straight to the free check (both existing Journey routes); a compact A/B choice heads the one supplier section; the three comparison introductions become one (every price-comparison figure kept); the Maker Showcase cards sit inside the supplier gallery.

removedBlocks: A garden room can give you a separate place to work, make art, exercise or spend time together. PlotNua brings the makers, pricing questions and planning conditions into one guide, so you can compare your options before asking for a quote.

Start with the use, then compare the complete project: the building, its insulation and glazing, delivery, installation, foundations, VAT and connections. A garden office used every working day and a weekend studio need different specifications. If somebody will live there, follow the separate garden-home guidance below.
Looking for makers? Explore garden room and garden office makers , then check the product details and the availability information for each option.

Working out a budget? The garden room prices guide separates published prices by what they cover. Use its checklist to ask about foundations, installation, VAT and electrical connection before comparing quotes.
Checking your garden? Read the planning conditions below and use the property check on this page. The conditions matter as much as the size of the building.
Choosing a garden office for everyday use

Ask the maker to explain the insulation in the floor, walls and roof, the glazing, ventilation and heating, and what is included in the quoted price. Think about where your desk will go, daylight on the screen, sockets and an internet connection. Ask how the building will reach your garden and whether the quote allows for your site.
Compare garden room makers and specifications.

These three researched examples show why the headline price needs a closer look. They are a starting point, not a ranking of suppliers or a complete market comparison. Open each guide for the published prices, source links and questions to take to the maker.
Two researched examples. Each guide identifies its sources and check date.
See what may be possible at your address now.
Before you can tell whether one garden room is dearer than another, you have to know what each price covers. Most of the time, it is not published.

So we are not going to tell you what a garden room costs in Ireland, and we are certainly not going to tell you what a garden home costs: the market has not published enough for anyone to say honestly. What we can tell you is what to ask.
